material_definitions: The study focuses on three series of LISICON solid solutions: Li3P(1-x)VxO4, Li(3+x)V(1-x)GexO4, and Li(3+x)P(1-x)GexO4 for x = 0, 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8, and 1.
X-ray powder diffraction analysis confirmed that these samples were phase pure, indexing to previously reported LISICON crystal structures.

The materials without partial lithium occupancy (Li3P(1-x)VxO4) were measured over 90 



C to 150 



C, while compounds with partial lithium occupancy (Li(3+x)V(1-x)GexO4 and Li(3+x)P(1-x)GexO4) were measured from -30 



C to 150 



C.
Aliovalent substitution creating partial lithium occupancy resulted in conductivity increases of 4-5 orders of magnitude and large reductions in activation energy relative to Li3PO4 and Li3VO4.
